title: Bulk Builds
description: Select characters and build contexts to process in a deterministic queue.
integrationNote: The queue is ready for the shared solver service. Solver execution is intentionally not simulated until that service is exposed.
preflightDescription: Before running, confirm the same settings used by each character's Optimize tab.
preflightTargetWarning: If a character has no Optimization Target selected, open its team Optimize tab and select one before running.
preflightArtifactDescription: Use Artifact Set Configuration in the Optimize tab to keep all artifact sets active and Rainbow Builds disabled.
